name: Flaky Monitor Report Persistence

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  flaky-monitor-persistence:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download flaky report artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: ./reports
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Upload flaky report to persistent storage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report-persistent
          path: ./reports/
          retention-days: 30

  flaky-monitor-report:
    needs: flaky-monitor-persistence
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download persistent flaky report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report-persistent
          path: ./reports

      - name: Setup Testspace
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Publish flaky test results
